The ‘ready-to-make’ files are a strong selling point.', 'Market Size and Demand': '• Moderate – addresses a niche market (makers, toolboard manufacturers), but the potential for growth is reasonable.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• Shows a working concept, but the ‘new app’ timeline is vague and reliant on external contractors. The roadmap is somewhat basic.', 'Revenue Model and Sustainability': '• Uncertain – relies on in-app ordering and potential partnerships, which are not clearly defined.', 'Differentiation': '• Limited – existing CAD software offers similar functionality, though the phone scanning approach is unique.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• Weak – relies on the team’s experience and claims of ‘sustainable manufacturing partners’ without concrete evidence.', 'Risk Awareness and Mitigation': '• Reasonable – identifies key risks but mitigation strategies are somewhat generic. The reliance on AI-generated code is a notable concern.', 'Pros': '• Working prototype demonstrates core functionality.
• Clear target audience.
• Identifies key risks and proposes basic mitigations.', 'Cons': '• Vague development timeline.
• Uncertain revenue model.

• Reliance on external contractors raises concerns.'}, 'Project B': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Strong – addresses a critical problem (lack of trust in digital provenance) with a novel solution (verifiable digital fingerprints).', 'Market Size and Demand': '• Large – targets a growing market of brands and consumers concerned with ethical sourcing and transparency.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• Detailed – outlines a phased approach with technical validation, pilot programs, and a phased rollout. The planned widget is a smart move.', 'Revenue Model and Sustainability': '• Solid – subscription-based model with a clear path to monetization and potential for upsells.', 'Differentiation': '• High – offers a unique approach to provenance verification that goes beyond simple tracking, focusing on verifiable, tamper-proof digital records.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• Good – proposes a registry of ethical standards and a pilot program to validate the technology and user engagement.', 'Risk Awareness and Mitigation': '• Adequate – addresses potential risks related to data privacy, scalability, and adoption.', 'Pros': '• Addresses a significant market need.
• Detailed and phased development plan.
• Strong revenue model.
• High level of differentiation.
